name: NYC Human Powered Boat Launches
description:
This dataset lists 63 human-powered boat launch sites across New York City, such as kayak and canoe access points at parks, landings, and clubs. Each record includes the site name, the borough it is in (Queens, Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, or Staten Island), a link to more information (typically an NYC Parks page), and geographic coordinates (longitude and latitude) for the location.

The data can be used to map launch locations, compare how sites are distributed across boroughs, find nearby paddling access points for trip planning, or build recreation and outdoor-activity applications. The coordinates also support spatial analysis, such as measuring distances between launches or identifying areas with limited water access.
